request.description: Seamless loop, 3 rigid bands spinning IN THEIR OWN FIXED PLANES around the stationary globe. DIAGONAL band: rotate along its 45-degree inclined orbit, lower-left to upper-right in front, continuing behind. VERTICAL band: rotate in its upright polar plane, up the front, over the north pole, down behind, under the south pole. HORIZONTAL band: rotate in its equatorial plane, right-to-left in front, around the side, left-to-right behind. Each rotates about its OWN plane-normal axis; keep its tilt, circular shape, width and radius fixed. Engraved ticks travel with each band, visibly showing motion. Full turns, constant speed, continuous forward movement. Matching start/end orientation AND velocity; no rocking, reversal, stops or seam easing. Globe, globe grid, outer support and camera FIXED. Preserve crisp fine copperplate hatching, silver graduations and bone-white contours on black. Correct front/back occlusion. No merging, extra hoops, bending or whole-object rotation.
